sawyer-ros2-bridge.description: Ubuntu 22.04 x86_64 only. Requires external ROS 2 Humble under /opt/ros/humble, system Python 3.10, PyYAML and Ubuntu Boost 1.74 libraries. Contains only private ROS 1 C++ runtime libraries; installs no ROS distribution or Conda Python. Source Humble and this package's local_setup.bash before use.
sawyer-ros2-bridge.summary: Sawyer-specific ROS 1 bridge and Intera interfaces for existing system ROS 2 Humble
